key_naming: sb = StatsBomb side of the LOCAL external leg, wy = Wyscout/Pappalardo side, as one _-separated part of a key that concerns one provider, a convention most keys of the public run do not need; no key of this file, of results.json or of the LOCAL file of the external leg contains statsbomb, pappalardo or wyscout in any letter case or starts with SB_ (E-11 PIPELINE section 0, key names)
minutes_rule: per player-match min(lineups minutes, regulation_minutes_cap), summed over the player's league matches: E-11's minutes_regulation on the Wyscout side, imported unchanged
share_floor_counts: box_shot_share denominator rows: every neutral shot row of the player that survives the period filter, in the season or in the match set
split_rule: a match is in match set h (0 or 1) when the position of its game_id among the league's sorted unique game_ids of actions.parquet is h modulo 2
half_low_rule: spearman_brown(tanh(atanh(r_half) - interval_z / sqrt(n - 2 - g))), g the number of position groups kept in R; defined when r_half is finite, |r_half| < 1 and n - 2 - g >= 1, else the league is INCONCLUSIVE
within_position_rule: half_low_rule with g = 1, on the uncentred values of one position's players in R
context_limit_rule: a position is a context limit of a candidate when, in at least context_limit_leagues of the five leagues, its within-position lower bound is below reliability_band or is not computed (fewer than within_position_report_minimum players, or undefined); reported, never gating
position_centring_set: A, by broad position, value and column alike
baseline_tie_rule: every column whose correlation equals baseline_r is listed in closest_baselines, in battery order
top_k_tied_statement: The twelfth and thirteenth values are tied, so the twelve largest values do not name a set of players and no survivor count exists.

scalings.per action in the denominator set: per {singular noun of the denominator clause}

duel_or_interception_rule: the two numerator clauses of opp_half_defensive_actions with the zone removed, each row once, per 90 minutes

candidates.display_name: Open-play shots per 90 (no penalties, no direct free kicks)
candidates.e11_definition: aggregated_player_quantities.shot_volume: open_play_shots / minutes_regulation x 90, open_play_shot = Wyscout type shot

candidates.display_name: Location-only conversion value of open-play shots per 90 (not provider xG)
candidates.sentence: sum of location-only conversion value over shots starting in the opponent half, per 90 minutes
candidates.e11_definition: not graded by E-11 (its model is E-09's)

candidates.display_name: Share of open-play shots starting in the provider-drawn penalty area
candidates.sentence: count over shots starting in the penalty area, per shot
candidates.scaling: per action in the denominator set
candidates.e11_definition: not graded by E-11 at the player level (E-11 preregistration, what it cannot show)

candidates.display_name: Opponent-half ground defending duels and interception-flagged events per 90
candidates.sentence: count over ground defending duel records or interception-flagged events, starting in the opponent half, per 90 minutes
candidates.e11_definition: aggregated_player_quantities.opp_half_defensive_actions: opp_half_duel_or_interception / minutes_regulation x 90, a ground defending duel or an interception-flagged row with a finite start x above 0.5 and no sentinel start

model_family: unpenalised logistic regression, iteratively reweighted least squares, NumPy
model_domain: neutral type shot, start in zone opponent_half (start_x > 0.50 strictly, not a location sentinel)
gate_s_fit_rule: every model of gate_s_fit_models converged in every fold; M0 is the training goal rate and is not fitted; a challenger that did not converge in every fold is not selectable and fails nothing
calibration_fit_failure: a calibration slope or intercept fit that does not converge is None, and None fails its gate in that league
bootstrap_rule: np.random.default_rng([seed, league_position]).multinomial(n_matches, [1/n_matches] * n_matches, size=bootstrap_replicates) over the league's sorted game_ids; statistics recomputed from per-match sums; pooled statistics add the five leagues' resampled sums, replicate by replicate
gate_r2_gain: relative: (LL_MD - LL_instrument) / LL_MD on the pooled out-of-league predictions
auroc_rule: pooled over the concatenated out-of-league predictions of the five leagues; average ranks for ties
ece_binning_rule: sort by probability; for k = 1..ece_bins-1 the k-th cut is the first index at or after k*n/ece_bins at which the probability changes value; repeated cuts merge; rows with equal probability are never split between bins
mce_rule: largest absolute gap between mean probability and observed rate over the bins

registry_common.not_run_statement: E-09 is registered and not run. No candidate statistic and no estimate of the conversion model has been computed.

registry_candidate.scope: Outfield players with at least the frozen regulation minutes in the 2017/18 first divisions of Spain, England, Italy, Germany and France, public Wyscout event data (Pappalardo et al. 2019); player-season values; reliability within broad position, each league separately; positions listed under context_limits in results.json are outside the claim.
registry_candidate.non_claim: A descriptor of how often or where a player's recorded events occur, repeatable within one season among players of the same broad position. It does not say how well a player shoots or defends, it is not comparable across leagues or seasons, and the data were seen before the protocol was written, so the result is exploratory.

registry_instrument.scope: Open-play shots starting in the opponent half in the 2017/18 first divisions of Spain, England, Italy, Germany and France, public Wyscout event data (Pappalardo et al. 2019); each league predicted by a model estimated on the other four.
registry_instrument.non_claim: A location-only model of whether a shot became a goal, fitted out of league for research. It is not the provider's xG, says nothing about finishing or about a single shot, and enters no dated decision.

ESTABLISHED_NUMBER.statement: Repeatable between the two match sets of one season among players of the same broad position, with a reliability lower bound at or above the number threshold in at least four of the five leagues, and not a near-copy of any declared baseline statistic. It is not promoted and is not shown beside players in this release.

ESTABLISHED_BAND.statement: Repeatable between the two match sets of one season among players of the same broad position, with a reliability lower bound at or above the band threshold in at least four of the five leagues but at or above the number threshold in fewer than four, and not a near-copy of any declared baseline statistic. A band, never a point value; it is not promoted and is not shown beside players in this release.

NOT_ESTABLISHED_REDUNDANT.statement: Compared and not established. Closed as redundant by the frozen rule: in at least one league where it was evaluated, a statistic the project already has correlated with it above the ceiling declared before the test.

NOT_ESTABLISHED_CONFOUNDED.statement: Compared and not established. Rejected in more than half of the leagues where it was evaluated, and closed as confounded: a declared nuisance variable explained more of its variance than the ceiling declared before the test allows, the reason the frozen closure rule selects.

NOT_ESTABLISHED_UNRELIABLE.statement: Compared and not established. Rejected in more than half of the leagues where it was evaluated, and closed as not repeatable: between the two match sets of a season, among players of the same broad position, its reliability lower bound fell below the band threshold, the reason the frozen closure rule selects.

NOT_ESTABLISHED_INSTRUMENT.statement: Not evaluated as a candidate: the location-only conversion model it depends on did not meet its frozen out-of-league criteria.

NOT_ESTABLISHED_MIXED.statement: Compared and not established. It passed in fewer leagues than the frozen rule needs and was rejected in no more than half of the leagues where it was evaluated.

INCONCLUSIVE.statement: A frozen sample or data gate was not met in too many leagues, or the conversion model it depends on was not judged. Nothing was compared at the candidate level.

ACCEPTED.statement: Fitted out of league on the public event data of five leagues, the location-only conversion model met every frozen criterion on relative value within a league and on level.

ACCEPTED_WITHIN_LEAGUE.statement: Fitted out of league on the public event data of five leagues, the location-only conversion model met every frozen criterion on relative value within a league and failed at least one on level. Its values carry no goal unit and are never compared across leagues.

NOT_ESTABLISHED.statement: Fitted out of league, the location-only conversion model failed at least one frozen criterion on relative value within a league. No candidate that depends on it was evaluated.

INCONCLUSIVE.statement: A frozen sample gate of the model was not met, or a required model estimation did not converge. The model was not judged.

NOT_ESTABLISHED_REDUNDANT.headline: Too similar to {baseline}
NOT_ESTABLISHED_REDUNDANT.headline_tied: Too similar to statistics the project already has
NOT_ESTABLISHED_REDUNDANT.detail: Correlated with a statistic the project already has above the ceiling declared before the test, in the leagues where the frozen rule closed it. The analysis names the statistic and the leagues.

NOT_ESTABLISHED_CONFOUNDED.headline: Mostly explained by {nuisance}
NOT_ESTABLISHED_CONFOUNDED.detail: A variable declared before the test as one it must not be measuring explained more of its variance than the ceiling allows; that was the reason the frozen rule closed it.

NOT_ESTABLISHED_UNRELIABLE.headline: Not repeatable between two sets of a season's matches within a position
NOT_ESTABLISHED_UNRELIABLE.detail: Among players of the same broad position, its values in the odd- and even-numbered matches of the season did not agree closely enough; that was the reason the frozen rule closed it.

NOT_ESTABLISHED_INSTRUMENT.headline: Its conversion model was not accepted out of league
NOT_ESTABLISHED_INSTRUMENT.detail: The location-only model it depends on did not meet its frozen criteria on leagues it was not estimated on, so the candidate was not evaluated.

NOT_ESTABLISHED_MIXED.headline: Survived in too few leagues
NOT_ESTABLISHED_MIXED.detail: It passed the frozen rule in some leagues and not in enough of them, and was rejected in no more than half.

baseline_fill_rule: the battery column that is a closest baseline in the most leagues closed as REDUNDANT; when two or more columns share that count, headline_tied

baseline_prose.mean_x: mean pitch position along its length
baseline_prose.mean_y: mean pitch position across its width
baseline_prose.opp_half_on_ball_per_90: passes and touches in the opponent half per ninety minutes
baseline_prose.duel_or_interception_per_90: ground defending duels and interceptions over the whole pitch

nuisance_prose.box_shot_share: on-ball action count and open-play shot volume
nuisance_prose.opp_half_defensive_actions: the share of the team's ground duel records that name no player

sb_folder_digest_rule: galactico.validation.sb_reader.folder_manifest, as E-11 section 2 computes it; La_Liga is E-11's registered digest
sb_minutes_rule: galactico.validation.sb_reader.read_team_sheets minutes_regulation (E-11 rule 2) with cap regulation_minutes_cap, summed over the season
sb_position_rule: the group of sb_position_groups with most regulation minutes over the player's season spells; a tie goes to the group first in GK, DF, MD, FW order; a position name outside sb_position_groups stops the leg before any statistic
sb_battery_rule: compute_baselines on the leg's own frames, in which only shots of sb_open_play_shot_types carry type shot and other shots are dropped; the leg's battery columns are that provider's and are not compared with the public run's

sb_statements.REPLICATED: On the second provider's earlier season of four leagues, the candidate passed the same frozen rule in at least three of them. Provider and season changed together.
sb_statements.NOT_REPLICATED: On the second provider's earlier season of four leagues, the candidate was rejected by the same frozen rule in at least three of them. Provider and season changed together.
sb_statements.MIXED: On the second provider's earlier season of four leagues, the candidate neither passed nor was rejected in three of them.
sb_statements.INCONCLUSIVE: Fewer than three of the second provider's four leagues passed the frozen sample gates; nothing was compared.
sb_statements.INSTRUMENT_NOT_ACCEPTED: The location-only conversion model, refitted on the second provider's four leagues, did not meet its frozen criteria there; the candidate was not evaluated.

sb_level_shift_rule: reported in the LOCAL file only, never a token: for each league the mean over A of the full-season value; m_sb and m_wy the unweighted means of the four sb_folders leagues and of their wy_league_of_sb_folder leagues; shift = (m_sb - m_wy) / m_wy; null when a league has an empty A or m_wy is 0; not computed for shot_location_value
selfcheck_seed_rule: worlds: np.random.default_rng([selfcheck_seed, world_position, replicate, league_position]); instrument scenarios: np.random.default_rng([selfcheck_seed, 100 + scenario_position, replicate, league_position]); resampling inside the self-check as in the real run (bootstrap_rule)
selfcheck_predicate: for each world or scenario and each subject it names: the number of replicates whose token is in expected is at least minimum_replicates_matching, the number whose token is in never is zero, where an also entry exists, the number whose token is in also.tokens is at least also.minimum_replicates_matching; where failing_gate is named, a replicate counts as matching only if that gate is among its failed gates; each league assertion holds in every replicate league; each generator sanity bound holds

generator_sanity_rules.latent_value_rate: a player's latent shot rate times the mean of the truth model's probability over shots drawn at his distance scale
generator_sanity_rules.latent_rate_value_correlation: Pearson correlation of latent shot rate and latent value rate over the generator's population of player draws
generator_sanity_rules.latent_team_variance_share: var over teams of opp_half_duel_rate x (1 - team unattributed probability), divided by itself plus the expected Poisson variance per 90 of a regular's season value of opp_half_defensive_actions

synthetic_instrument_match_rule: each shot's game_id drawn uniformly from the league's synthetic_instrument_matches_per_league match ids

power_planning.rule: per league P(half_low >= threshold) = Phi(sqrt(n - 2 - g) * (atanh(rho) - atanh(t)) - interval_z), rho = R / (2 - R), t = threshold / (2 - threshold), g = 3; P(at least four of five) = p^5 + 5 p^4 (1 - p); the same true within-position reliability R in every league; no redundancy

selfcheck_feasibility.by: the reviser of 14 October 2026, event-level throwaway script on synthetic numbers only, the exact generator, gauntlet, rule and instrument gates of this config with 2000 bootstrap replicates; 40 replicates per world and scenario, seeds by selfcheck_seed_rule from replicate 0
selfcheck_feasibility.minimum_set_from: each minimum leaves at least a 0.98 chance that one subject passes when its miss rate is (observed misses + 1) / 40: 0.9971 for 10 of 12 at one miss in 40, 0.9804 for 10 of 12 at two (LEVEL_SHIFT), 0.9904 for 9 of 12 at three (PLANTED, ACCEPTED); never lists hold only tokens that would classify a planted truth as its opposite, none of which occurred

reuse_disclosure: prospective analysis plan on reused historical data; see preregistration.md section 2
